lhs: Slice of a low-padded unit-stride reduce-window, selecting the final singleton output on reduced axes and the whole range on retained axes.
rhs: Reduce the original input on the source-selected full-span axes; reshape the shorter output to the slice shape.
conditions: Arbitrary rank, legal static unit-stride Slice with stop=window output, start=window low padding, high padding zero, no stride/dilation, some padding, nonempty effective reductions; unit or selected full-window guard with common ordered nonreversed logical reads.
types: Any scalar payload, same pure binary reducer and initializer; exact arithmetic on a common logical order. No widened or reassociated floating evaluator claim.
overlap: Standalone unpadded FullSpanWindow.original_reduce_reshape supplies the canonical target geometry but omits this padded slice and matching guards. Historical paper source labels contain no matching slice-reduce-window terminal equation.
